'''Sleek''' was a species of flightless bird, hunted to near-extinction for their delicious meat centuries before the [[Galactic War]], with only one small colony surviving on a remote [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]] island around [[3630 BBY]].<ref name="Mission">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Get 'Em While They Last}}</ref>
